name: claudepad
description: A notepad pane for Claude Code: notes per repo, per branch or global, that Claude can read, add to and tick off. Tags, due dates, search, pinned context, and NOTES.md or git-folder sync.

editor.title: Editor for note links
editor.description: The editor a note's path:line opens in: vscode (code -g), cursor (cursor -g) or jetbrains (idea --line).

notesFolder.title: Notes folder
notesFolder.description: A folder to keep notes in, one JSON file per project, instead of Claude Code's plugin store. Point it at a git-tracked or synced folder to have your notes on every machine. Absolute, or starting with ~/. Empty keeps them in the plugin store.
